Evidence: Executive orders, Mayor's post, Public outcry
#Aletheia #USNews

Olive Branch Mayor Ken Adams argues lowering the flag for non-political icons lessens its meaning, reserving it strictly for major leaders and heroes.

The Unavoidable Lie: Refusing honors preserves reverence when it actually amplifies division.
